hq.label: Classroom
hq.prompt: A UK primary school classroom: group tables with chairs, a blank whiteboard, coat pegs, a display board with blank coloured paper, plants on the windowsill, big windows with daylight.

hq.label: Playground
hq.prompt: A UK school playground: a climbing frame, painted hopscotch shapes without numbers, benches, a low fence and trees, a sunny day.

hq.label: Library
hq.prompt: A school library corner: low bookshelves with colourful blank book spines, beanbags, a rug and a reading lamp.

hq.label: Quiet room
hq.prompt: A calm sensory room: soft mats, beanbags, a small tent, fairy lights, soft blue and purple light.

hq.label: Lunch hall
hq.prompt: An empty, tidy school lunch hall: long tables, stacked trays, a serving counter; calm and quiet.

hq.label: Home
hq.prompt: A cosy room at home: a sofa with blankets, a rug, a shelf with toys and plants, warm lamp light.

hq.label: Space
hq.prompt: Outer space: a small rocky moon surface as the floor, planets and stars in the sky, a distant spaceship.

hq.label: Under the sea
hq.prompt: Under the sea: a sandy floor, coral, seaweed, bubbles, light rays from above.

hq.label: Jungle
hq.prompt: A jungle clearing: mossy ground, giant leaves, hanging vines, a waterfall far behind.

hq.label: City rooftop
hq.prompt: A city rooftop at night: a flat roof as the floor, a water tower, a skyline with lit windows, the moon.

hq.label: Sky castle
hq.prompt: A castle on a floating island above the clouds: a stone courtyard floor, towers with plain pennants, clouds below.

hq.label: Secret lab
hq.prompt: A secret spy base: a round vault door, consoles with glowing buttons, radar screens and a wall map made of abstract shapes, all without writing.

situations.label: Too loud
situations.prompt: A school lunch hall full of bean figures, with big jagged sound-wave shapes bursting from every side and clattering trays.

situations.label: Nobody gets what I mean
situations.prompt: Two bean figures looking puzzled at an empty space in the centre; floating speech bubbles filled with scribbles and question marks.

situations.label: Waiting
situations.prompt: A long school corridor with a queue of bean figures, a big wall clock and an hourglass; a gap in the queue in the centre foreground.

situations.label: I did it!
situations.prompt: A gold trophy, stars and confetti bursting around an empty spotlight circle in the centre; bean figures clapping at the sides.

situations.label: Asked to answer
situations.prompt: A classroom seen from the side: bean figures at desks all turning to look at an empty chair in the centre, lit by a spotlight; a blank whiteboard behind.

situations.label: Someone is unkind
situations.prompt: A playground corner: two bean figures at the edge with spiky dark speech bubbles pointing at an empty space in the centre; a small grey cloud above that space.

situations.label: Plans change
situations.prompt: A visual timetable of blank picture cards on a wall; one card flipping over and swapping with a big question-mark card; swirling arrows.

situations.label: Somewhere new
situations.prompt: An open doorway glowing with light into an unfamiliar room with unknown shapes; footprints leading from the empty centre foreground to the door.

situations.label: Playtime
situations.prompt: A sunny playground: bean figures playing tag and ball at the edges, a ball mid-bounce, open space in the centre.

situations.label: Tricky work
situations.prompt: A school desk at the bottom of the picture with a worksheet of tangled scribble lines (no letters), a broken pencil, crumpled paper balls, and a small storm cloud of squiggles above.

stickers.label: Cochlear implant
stickers.prompt: A cochlear implant sound processor with its round coil, in a bright colour.

stickers.label: Ear defenders
stickers.prompt: Chunky children's ear defenders in a bright colour.

stickers.label: Talker

stickers.label: Tangle

stickers.label: Gadget belt
stickers.prompt: A utility belt with small pouches and a buckle.

stickers.label: Spy watch
stickers.prompt: A spy gadget wristwatch with a glowing blank screen.

powers.label: Slow everybody down
powers.prompt: A big friendly tortoise carrying a round clock on its shell, with soft wavy slow-motion lines behind it.

powers.label: Pause the world
powers.prompt: A big round pause button with two bars, with tiny ice crystals frozen round its edge.

powers.label: Hold my turn
powers.prompt: A glowing golden ticket with a star in the middle, like a token that saves your turn.

powers.label: Warn me first
powers.prompt: A friendly bell ringing, with three dots in an arc beside it lighting up one after another.

powers.label: Say it again
powers.prompt: A speech bubble with a curved replay arrow looping round it.

powers.label: Turn the room down

powers.label: Dim the lights
powers.prompt: A light bulb glowing softly beside a slider switch pushed halfway down.

powers.label: Quiet bubble
powers.prompt: A bean figure sitting calmly inside a big shiny bubble, with jagged sound waves bouncing off the outside.

powers.label: Translator
powers.prompt: A small machine with two windows: a picture of a house goes in one side and comes out of the other as a speech bubble with a house in it, with arrows going both ways.

powers.label: Everyone talks my way
powers.prompt: A row of bean figures all copying the same big wave as a leader bean figure in front.

powers.label: Get-what-I-mean ray
powers.prompt: A ray gun shooting a beam of light into a speech bubble, which lights up with a light bulb inside.

powers.label: Control teachers
powers.prompt: A chunky game controller; above it, a taller bean figure with a lanyard happily follows a big curved arrow, mid-step.

powers.label: Question swap
powers.prompt: A small bean figure and a taller bean figure with a lanyard; two speech bubbles with question marks swap places between them along curved arrows.

powers.label: Pass
powers.prompt: A calm bean figure holding up a green card, with a curved arrow jumping over a dot above it.

powers.label: Invisibility cloak
powers.prompt: A flowing cloak whose lower half fades into sparkles and becomes see-through.

powers.label: Control all displays
powers.prompt: A remote control pointing at a big wall screen that glows with bright swirls of colour.

powers.label: Control devices
powers.prompt: A remote control in the middle, with a lamp, a speaker and a whiteboard around it, each joined to it by a little spark.

powers.label: See my points
powers.prompt: A big gold star with one open eye in its middle.

powers.label: Change a rule
powers.prompt: A paper scroll unrolling, with a pencil drawing new simple shapes on it.

powers.label: Speak for your friends
powers.prompt: Two bean figures side by side holding mitten hands; one has a big speech bubble with a small heart in it.

powers.label: Call an ally
powers.prompt: A megaphone sending out soft signal waves, and a second bean figure running in to help.

powers.label: Team up
powers.prompt: Two bean figures doing a high five, with sparkles.

doors.label: Sound and light

doors.label: Words

doors.label: Turns

doors.label: Screens

doors.label: Together

display.label: Shore
display.prompt: Ignore "square". A calm seaside seen from the beach at golden hour: smooth sand across the bottom third, small gentle waves, and a wide soft sky with a low sun and a few clouds. Lots of empty space and nothing on the sand. Wide landscape; it will be cropped to 16:9, so keep everything important in the middle band.

display.label: Board

display.label: Bottle

display.label: Teacher figure
display.prompt: A taller bean figure wearing a lanyard, standing, front view, arms relaxed.

cards.label: Like me

cards.label: A bit like me

cards.label: Someone else

cards.label: Talking
